name: The Chikafag and Chika
source:
The Chikafag, an amnesiac man who recently moved into the small sea side town of Uchiura,
falls in love with a girl named Takami Chika he meets there.
Chika falls for The Chikafag too and everything is alright in the world.
... That is, until someone decides they can't allow their relationship to develop any further.
 
Featuring The Chikafag and Chika and The Chikafag Returns adapted into VN format along with a brand new 3rd arc!
translation:
Chikafag是一名失忆男子，最近搬到了海边小镇内浦，
爱上了在那里遇到的一个名叫高见千花的女孩。
Chika也爱上了Chikafag，世界上一切都好。
……也就是说，直到有人决定他们不能让他们的关系进一步发展。
 
以The Chikafag and Chika和The Chikafag Returns为特色，改编成VN格式以及全新的第三弧线！
